jingle.use: Title jingle, plays once after 'Los geht's!' during the intro

lobby.use: Background loop in the lobby / setup / between categories

think.use: Quiet loop while a question is open

sting.use: Reveal of the correct answer / category scoreboard

stingShort.use: Short hit: category intro card, 'all answered'

survival-intro.use: Survival-Finale: start of the finale / rules intro

survival-elevator-jolt.use: Survival-Finale: the elevator drops (−200), together with survival-wrong

survival-elevator-rise.use: Survival-Finale: start sequence – all elevators ride up to their start score (~3 s)

survival-decay-tick.use: Survival-Finale: every −10 of the live decay

survival-splash.use: Survival-Finale: elimination, on the impact in the slime

survival-slime-bubble-loop.use: Survival-Finale: the slime's constant bubbling (whole file loops seamlessly)

survival-slime-threat-loop.use: Survival-Finale: threatening bubbling from CRITICAL, volume by danger

survival-warning-lamp-loop.use: Survival-Finale: warning lamp while someone is ELIMINATION_IMMINENT
